mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.content, c.parent_id AS parentId, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, u.id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickName, u.avatar FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
